text# Busser

Busser is a home bar management web app. Track your bottle and ingredient inventory,
discover cocktails you can make with what you have on hand, and collaborate with friends
in shared workspaces.

## Pages

- [Home](https://busserapp.com/): landing page and browsable cocktail catalog
- [About](https://busserapp.com/about): what Busser is and who it's for
- [Sign up](https://busserapp.com/signup): create an account
- [Log in](https://busserapp.com/login): sign in to an existing account
